title: Minification can benefit from using single quotation marks on strings
impact: Size only, no behavior change. 3 reactions plus 2 commenters; common for inline SVG data URLs written with double-quoted attributes inside single-quoted url(). Bootstrap-style SVGs already use single quotes inside double, which are unaffected. Saves one byte per escaped quote (8 bytes for the reporter's example), much less after gzip.
code: src/values/url.rs: Url::to_css (minify branch chooses quoted vs unquoted)
summary: Strings and url() are always written with double quotes, so any `"` inside gets escaped even when single quotes would need no escapes. Both forms parse to the same value; choosing the quote that needs fewer escapes is a safe size win when minifying.
repro: 313-repro.mjs. `.a{content:url('data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns="..." width="16">...')}` -> `url("data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns=\"...\" width=\"16\">...")`; `content:'say "hi"'` -> `"say \"hi\""`; `font-family:'My "Quoted" Font'` -> escaped. All outputs round-trip (re-parse equal). Same on local, 1.33.0, 1.32.0, 1.31.1. Controls (no inner quotes, apostrophes only) correctly stay double-quoted.
evidence: Round-trip checked in the repro via a second transform; Chromium 153 parses `'a"b"c'` and `url('a"b')` to the same value as the double-quoted forms (CSSOM re-serializes both with double quotes, as CSSOM requires). Escape terminators: Chromium distinguishes `"\a  b"` (newline, space, b) from `"\a b"` (newline, b), relevant to PR #1025.

fix.approach: In minify mode, count `"` vs `'` and pick the quote with fewer escapes, delegating all other escaping to cssparser's CssStringWriter (keeps hex-escape terminators correct). Apply to url() first (PR #1338), then generalize to CSSString/FamilyName/attribute values/token-list strings if wanted.

openPRs.assessment: Recommend reviewing first. URL-only and minify-only; single-quote writer handles only the quote characters and delegates everything else to CssStringWriter, so escape terminators stay correct; ties keep double quotes; dependency placeholders and non-minified output unchanged. Thorough tests (2,744-combination round-trip, source maps, dependencies). Fixes the reporter's url() example but not `content: '..."...'` strings or font-family names. Branch is behind master.

Do not merge as is. Replaces serialize_string everywhere (also in non-minified output) with a new src/serialize.rs. Its hex_escape omits the terminating space unless the next byte is a hex digit, so a control character followed by a space loses the space: value "\n b" (source `"\a  b"`) would be written `"\a b"`, which Chromium reads as "\nb". Adds `cssparser-macros = "*"` (wildcard dependency) just for match_byte. Covers more string sites than #1338, so could be revisited after fixing the escape and limiting it to minify.

notVerified: Neither PR built or run; the #1025 escape bug was found by reading the diff against cssparser's hex_escape (which always writes the trailing space) and checked in Chromium, not by running the PR.
